source.label: 38-Cloud GitHub repo (test scene IDs) + Planetary Computer Landsat STAC
source.method: WRS-2 path/row/date parsed from the Landsat product IDs listed in the repo, scene centre from the matching Planetary Computer landsat-c2-l2 STAC item

38-cloud.note: 21 of 38 scenes located (20 test scenes + 1 training scene named in the repo); the other 17 training scene IDs are only in training_sceneids_38-Cloud.csv inside the Kaggle/Drive archive. All scenes are Landsat 8 over North/South America (2016).

source.label: AGBD_raw parquet shards (Hugging Face)
source.method: GEDI footprint lat/lon from the metadata columns of 60 randomly chosen parquet shards (of 2658), read by HTTP range requests

agbd.note: Points are GEDI L4A footprints (one per 25x25 px patch); 359,715 read from 60 of 2658 shards, 3,000 kept. Per README the dataset covers S2 tiles in 11 regions; n_total from the AGBD_raw dataset_info.

source.label: AgriFieldNet India TACO metadata (METADATA/sample.parquet in agrifieldnet-india.zip, Hugging Face isp-uv-es/agrifieldnet-india-taco)
source.method: centre lon/lat (ml:lon, ml:lat) of every 256x256 tile, read from the zip via HTTP range requests

agrifieldnet-india.note: 1,165 tiles ({'train': 929, 'validation': 236}) in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Odisha and Bihar; 5820 field ids counted in the tile metadata (7,081 fields in the original release).

source.label: TorchGeo AI4Arctic rehost metadata.csv (region ids) + approximate region centres
source.method: one approximate centre per CIS/DMI ice-chart region named in metadata.csv; per-scene coordinates sit inside 60 GB NetCDF tarballs and were not read

ai4arctic-autoice.note: 532 scenes (513 train, 20 test) over 16 regions; scenes per region: SGRDIEA 48, SGRDIFOXE 43, CapeFarewell_RIC 41, CentralEast_RIC 41, SGRDINFLD 41, Qaanaaq_RIC 39, NorthWest_RIC 39, NorthEast_RIC 38, CentralWest_RIC 36, SGRDIWA 32, North_RIC 31, SouthWest_RIC 28, SouthEast_RIC 27, SGRDIMID 25, SGRDIHA 20, NorthAndCentralEast_RIC 3. Region centres are hand-placed, not from the data.

source.label: AI4Boundaries sampling GeoPackage (JRC FTP)
source.method: centroid of each sample polygon in ai4boundaries_sampling.gpkg (EPSG:3035 -> WGS84)

ai4boundaries.note: 7831 samples (4 km cells), 2019: Austria 2091, France 2078, Sweden 1420, Netherlands 1157, Catalonia 652, Slovenia 301, Luxembourg 132.

source.label: AI4SmallFarms on DANS Data Station (Dataverse)
source.method: centre of each sentinel-2-asia label-mask GeoTIFF (train/validate/test), from headers read over HTTP and reprojected to WGS84

ai4smallfarms.note: 62 S2 tiles in Cambodia and Vietnam (the PANGAEA subset); the deposit also holds 87 Netherlands tiles (sentinel-2-nl) not used by the benchmark and not plotted.

source.label: Kaggle Airbus Ship Detection Challenge
source.method: no georeferencing in the JPEG crops and no public index of image locations; Kaggle download not accessible

airbus-ships.note: ~192k 768x768 px crops with RLE ship masks (train_ship_segmentations_v2.csv); locations are not disclosed by Airbus.

source.label: Allen Coral Atlas methods page
source.method: bounding box of the tropical reef band (30N-30S) the Atlas maps; region polygons and map tiles require an Atlas login

allen-coral-atlas-maps.note: Wall-to-wall PlanetScope-derived geomorphic and benthic maps of shallow reefs worldwide; no public per-region or validation-point index without an account, so only the latitude band is drawn.

source.label: Copernicus-Bench airquality_s5p.zip (Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each annual NO2 S5P GeoTIFF tile (EPSG:3035) read from the zip via HTTP range requests

aq-no-s5p-aq-o-s5p.note: 2,467 EEA 1 km-grid tiles over Europe; identical tile set for NO2 and O3 (train/val/test 1480/493/494).

source.label: AquaSat sr_wq_rs_join.csv (figshare)
source.method: distinct lat/long of matchup sites parsed from 80 byte-range slices of the CSV (124,547 matchup rows sampled)

aquasat.note: n_total is the matchup-row count estimated from file size / mean row length (paper: >600,000 matchups); 14,829 distinct sites seen in the sampled slices, 3,000 drawn. CONUS lakes/rivers/estuaries (WQP, LAGOS).

source.label: BigEarthNet v2 metadata.parquet (Hugging Face mirror)
source.method: 1200 m patch centres decoded from the MGRS tile and patch column/row index in each patch_id (480,038 patches in the metadata file)

bigearthnet-v1-v2-reben.note: reBEN has 549,488 S1/S2 patch pairs; this metadata copy lists 480,038 patch ids over 54 Sentinel-2 tiles in 10 countries. v1 patches are a subset of the same grid.

source.label: Copernicus-Bench biomass_s3.zip (Hugging Face) file listing
source.method: patch centres decoded from the CCI-Biomass 10-degree tile id and row/column index in each label filename, read from the zip central directory

biomass-s3.note: 5000 AGB label patches (282 px at 100 m) with 3-5 Sentinel-3 OLCI views each; train/val/test 3000/1000/1000.

source.label: BioMassters on Hugging Face
source.method: Finland bounding box only; the chip GeoTIFFs carry no CRS/geotransform and the metadata CSVs hold no coordinates

biomassters.note: ~13,000 anonymised 2,560 m chips (8,689 train AGBM labels + test) over Finnish forest; chip locations are withheld by design (Finnish Forest Centre LiDAR AGB reference), so no sample-level points exist.

source.label: BraDD-S1TS meta.csv (inside the Zenodo zip)
source.method: one point per Brazilian state listed in meta.csv (approximate state centres); the dataset publishes no sample coordinates

bradd-s1ts.note: 25,988 Sentinel-1 time-series samples (~2.5 km) across the Legal Amazon; per-state counts: PA 11604, MT 3264, AM 2901, RO 2875, AC 2329, RR 1457, MA 1048, AP 390, TO 120. The .pt samples carry image/label/dates only; the true centre map exists only as pictures/CenterLocationMap.svg in the GitHub repo.

source.label: BreizhCrops 2017 parcel shapefiles (S3 bucket used by the breizhcrops package)
source.method: parcel polygon centroids from the four regional shapefiles, 1500 random parcels per region

breizhcrops.note: Parcels per region (2017): {'frh01': 221095, 'frh02': 180565, 'frh03': 207993, 'frh04': 158522}. Total transfer ~190 MB (four tar.gz archives), slightly above the 150 MB guideline to avoid dropping a department.

source.label: SustainBench brick kiln dataset page
source.method: bounding box of Bangladesh, the coverage stated in the docs; the per-chip bounds live in HDF5/CSV files on Google Drive

brick-kilns.note: 6,329 kiln and 67,284 no-kiln 64 px Sentinel-2 chips (Oct 2018-May 2019) over Bangladesh; data on Google Drive (folder 1VvDQHTorD8sa6YJ6_Z9UoEFGu7QpR2dT), not reachable here.

source.label: BRIGHT target.zip label GeoTIFFs (Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each georeferenced building-damage label tile, read from the zip via HTTP range requests

bright.note: 4246 1024x1024 tiles over 14 events: bata-explosion, beirut-explosion, congo-volcano, haiti-earthquake, hawaii-wildfire, la_palma-volcano, libya-flood, marshall-wildfire, mexico-hurricane, morocco-earthquake, myanmar-hurricane, noto-earthquake, turkey-earthquake, ukraine-conflict.

source.label: CaBuAr metadata.parquet (Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each 512x512 patch from its UTM x/y coordinate vectors, reprojected to WGS84; pre/post pairs deduplicated

cabuar.note: 318 fire events, each tiled into up to 121 patches.

source.label: AOI shapefiles inside the Zenodo UAV archives listed by FoMo-Bench (Woody: Pinus/Ulex/Acacia, Spekboom, Waititu) + Cactus study area
source.method: centroid of each labelled orthomosaic's AOI polygon, read from the zips via HTTP range requests; Cactus (Kaggle, no georeference) as one approximate study-area point

cactus-woody-spekboom-waititu.note: Sites per dataset: {'cactus': 1, 'woody/pinus': 4, 'woody/ulex': 4, 'woody/acacia': 2, 'spekboom': 31, 'waititu': 3}. Each AOI is a UAV plot of ~0.01-1 km2; the Cactus point is the Tehuacan-Cuicatlan reserve centre, not a measured location.

source.label: ESSD paper (Gourmelon et al. 2022) glacier list; data on PANGAEA
source.method: one hand-placed terminus coordinate per glacier named in the paper; the PANGAEA zip has no per-image geolocation index

caffe.note: 681 SAR images (ERS, Envisat, RADARSAT-1, ALOS, TSX/TDX, S1; 1995-2020) of 7 glaciers: Columbia Glacier, Alaska; Jakobshavn Isbrae, Greenland; Mapple Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Crane Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Jorum Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Dinsmoor-Bombardier-Edgeworth, Antarctic Peninsula; Sjogren Inlet, Antarctic Peninsula. Test set = Mapple and Columbia.

source.label: CAS Landslide study-area shapefiles (Zenodo)
source.method: centroid of each study-area polygon in 'study areas shp.zip' (one per region/sensor), reprojected to WGS84

cas-landslide.note: 11 study-area polygons for the 9 regions (Hokkaido; Jiuzhai valley; Lombokt; Longxi River; Mengdong; Moxi town; Moxitaidi; Palu; Tiburon Peninsula (Planet); Tiburon Peninsula (Sentinel)t; wenchuan); the 20,865 chips are not individually georeferenced in a public index, so points are site centroids, not samples.

source.label: benin-cashews TACO repackaging (ISP-UV, Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each of the 20 georeferenced 2.56 km label chips, from the GeoTIFF headers of the label chips read inside the zip over HTTP, EPSG:32631 -> WGS84

cashew-plantation.note: One Sentinel-2 scene in central Benin (Collines), 2019-11 to 2020-10. GEO-Bench m-cashew-plant has 1,800 samples but its HDF5 export gives every sample the same transform, so only the scene's 20-chip grid is plottable.

source.label: CH4Net paper, Table 2 (site longitude/latitude)
source.method: lon/lat of the 23 super-emitter sites from Table 2 of the AMT paper; all 10,046 images are crops centred on these sites

ch4net.note: Hugging Face dataset av555/ch4net is gated (login required); site table from the open-access paper used instead. Several sites are within a few km of each other.

source.label: Chesapeake Land Cover CVPR-2019 spatial_index.geojson (inside the LILA zip)
source.method: polygon centroid of every NAIP tile in spatial_index.geojson, read from the 150 GB zip with range requests

chesapeake-land-cover.note: 732 1 m NAIP tiles across DE, MD, NY, PA, VA, WV (splits: {'test': 120, 'train': 582, 'val': 30}). GEO-Bench m-chesapeake has 5,014 256 px chips cut from these tiles with no georeferencing in the HDF5s, so chips are not located individually.

source.label: Copernicus-Bench cloud_s3.zip (Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each cloud_multi label GeoTIFF (EPSG:4326) read from the zip via HTTP range requests

source.label: tacofoundation/cloudsen12 (TACO footer metadata, L1C parts)
source.method: stac:centroid of every L1C patch read from the parquet footer of the 5 .taco parts via HTTP range requests

cloudsen12-cloud-s2.note: Each ROI contributes ~5 patches at the same location (different dates); high, scribble and nolabel label types included.

source.label: CropHarvest labels.geojson (Zenodo 10251170)
source.method: lon/lat of every label point in labels.geojson (one point per sample)

source.label: CropNet USDA Crop Dataset CSVs (Hugging Face) + Census county gazetteer
source.method: distinct state+county FIPS from the county-level yield CSVs (4 crops, 2016-2022), placed at Census gazetteer county centroids

cropnet.note: 2189 counties with at least one yield label; 0 FIPS not matched in the 2023 gazetteer. Imagery HDF5s are per state and carry no public per-county index.

source.label: Rustowicz et al. 2019 (CVPRW), Figure 1 map frames
source.method: corners of the two map frames in the paper's Figure 1 (northern Ghana; South Sudan); no public coordinate index

croptypemapping-ghana-south-sudan.note: 3,563 64x64 tiles (Ghana 2,878; South Sudan 685) listed by id only in roserustowicz/crop-type-mapping; imagery and labels are on Google Drive (SustainBench) and the Radiant MLHub records are offline. Field locations were jittered up to 3 km for anonymity even in the paper.

source.label: CY-Bench centroids.zip (Zenodo)
source.method: centroid point of every administrative unit in the per-country centroid shapefiles (adm_id), EPSG:4326

cy-bench.note: 11,432 administrative units in 43 countries (largest: BR 5572, US 3233, IN 585, AR 526, DE 401); 3,000 units stored. Maize and wheat yield series are per unit-year (BR shapefile has no CRS and is taken as WGS84).

source.label: DeepGlobe 2018 challenge paper (arXiv 1805.06561)
source.method: JPEG tiles carry no georeferencing and the paper names only the countries (Thailand, Indonesia, India); Kaggle/CodaLab distribution not accessible

deepglobe-roads.note: 8,570 tiles (6,226 train / 1,243 val / 1,101 test) at 0.5 m; the country-level footprint is already carried by the dataset record.

source.label: Robinson et al. 2021 (contest outcome paper), Fig. 2 region list
source.method: one city-centre point per region named in the outcome paper; the released patches deliberately carry no georeferencing

dfc2020.note: 6,114 256 px S1+S2 patches (986 validation, 5,128 test) from seven cities: Khabarovsk, Russia; Mumbai, India; Kippa-Ring, Australia; Mexico City, Mexico; Bandar Anzali, Iran; Black Forest, Germany; Cape Town, South Africa. Copernicus-Bench rehost on Hugging Face (dfc2020.zip, 8.8 GB) has identity geotransforms.

source.label: DOTA dataset page
source.method: no coordinates: images are non-georeferenced PNG/JPEG (Google Earth, GF-2, JL-1, aerial) on Google Drive/Baidu with box annotations only

dota-v2-isaid.note: 5,229 DOTA-v2 images (iSAID: 2,806 from DOTA-v1) with no public location metadata; described only as 'global' in the papers.

source.label: Dynamic World tile metadata (PANGAEA)
source.method: lon/lat of every labelled tile from v1_dw_tile_metadata_for_public_release.xlsx

dynamic-world-training-set.note: 24,530 tile labels (Non-expert: 20,336, Experts: 4,194); the 409 validation tiles are in validation_set_tiles.zip and are not listed in the metadata table. 3,000 tiles stored.

source.label: DynamicEarthNet TACO repackaging, .tacocat/sample.parquet (ml:lon, ml:lat per AOI)
source.method: one point per AOI cube from the per-sample lon/lat in the TACO metadata, cross-checked against the XYZ zoom-13 tile index encoded in each AOI id

dynamicearthnet.note: 73 of the 75 AOIs are present in the TACO repackaging (1,752 monthly samples; two cubes missing). Each AOI is a 1024x1024 px cube at 3 m (~3 km).

source.label: NASA CMR granule search, EMITL2BCH4PLM V002
source.method: mean of the bounding-polygon vertices of every plume-complex granule returned by the CMR granule search

emit-l2b-ch-plumes.note: 1686 plume-complex granules in CMR at build time; the collection grows as EMIT acquires and the team reviews new plumes.

source.label: EuroCropsML preprocess.zip per-parcel .npz 'center' (Zenodo 15095445)
source.method: parcel centroids from 3000 .npz members sampled in 3 contiguous windows of the randomly ordered zip, via HTTP range requests

source.label: EuroSAT_MS.zip (Zenodo)
source.method: centre of 300 randomly chosen multispectral 640 m patches, from GeoTIFF headers read inside the zip over HTTP, UTM -> WGS84

eurosat.note: 27,000 patches in 10 classes over 34 European countries; 300 sampled (seed 0). The EuroSAT-SAR companion shares the same patch locations.

source.label: weecology/everwatch-predictions v0.1.1 PredictedBirds.shp (Zenodo 11192497)
source.method: median location of georeferenced bird detections per colony (Site attribute) for the 2020-2022 surveys, 34 colonies in Florida

everwatch.note: Dataset images (4,438 train / 493 val / 196 test PNG crops, Zenodo 17317117, 22 GB) carry no coordinates; colony locations come from the companion georeferenced prediction shapefile over the same surveys, so this is the set of surveyed colonies rather than per-crop positions.

source.label: FTW chips_<country>.parquet GeoParquet files (source.coop)
source.method: bbox centres of the chip polygons in the 25 per-country chips_*.parquet files

fields-of-the-world.note: 70817 chips across 25 country/region folders (Corsica is listed separately from France).

source.label: Five-Billion-Pixels project page
source.method: mainland China bounding box; the scene coordinate file is only on Google Drive/Baidu and the HF mirror's patches are not georeferenced

five-billion-pixels.note: 150 GF-2 scenes (6800x7200 px, 4 m) across China; the project page announces a coordinate file but it is distributed only via Google Drive / Baidu, which this environment cannot reach.

source.label: FLAIR aerial patch metadata (flair_aerial_metadata.json)
source.method: patch_centroid_x/y of every 512x512 aerial patch, reprojected Lambert-93 -> WGS84

source.label: FLUXNET2015 site list (AmeriFlux site_display API used by fluxnet.org)
source.method: tower lat/lon of all 212 FLUXNET2015 sites from the site-list API

fluxnet2015.note: 206 of 212 sites carry CC-BY-4.0 site-years; the rest are Tier 2 only. One point per tower, not per site-year.

source.label: fMoW-RGB parquet mirror on Hugging Face (polygon column)
source.method: centroids of the WKT raw_location polygon of every fMoW-RGB train/val image, read from the parquet shards with HTTP range requests

fmow.note: 416613 fMoW-RGB train+val images (the test set and the full-res multispectral release are not in this mirror); multi-temporal views share a site. 56.0 MB transferred.

source.label: ForestNet train/val/test CSVs (inside ForestNetDataset.zip)
source.method: latitude/longitude columns of the split CSVs, read from the zip via HTTP range requests

forestnet.note: 2757 forest-loss events in Indonesia, 2001-2016 (train 1616, test 668, val 473); each example is a Landsat 8 composite centred on the event polygon.

source.label: GMW v3 tile index (gmw_v3_tiles.geojson, Zenodo 6894273)
source.method: centre of each 1x1 degree GMW product tile polygon in the tile index

global-mangrove-watch-v3-v4.note: Tiles are 1-degree cells that contain mangroves; the map product itself is a raster/vector extent, not samples.

source.label: GPW VHR interpretation tile index (Zenodo 15631655)
source.method: centroids of the 8199 1 km VHR interpretation tiles (EPSG:3857 -> 4326); n_total is the sum of per-tile sample counts

global-pasture-watch-grassland-samples.note: 8199 tiles hold the point samples; per-point gpkg (940 MB) not downloaded.

source.label: zhu-xlab/GlobalBuildingMap assets/merged_roi.geojson
source.method: centre of each processed 0.2-degree PlanetScope mosaic tile, decoded from the W_N_E_S corners in the feature's file name

globalbuildingmap.note: 200724 mosaic-tile ROIs built from 790,101 PlanetScope scenes (0 centres taken from the Web Mercator geometry instead of the name). Product rasters are 5-degree tiles on mediaTUM.

source.label: GLORIA_meta_and_lab.csv inside GLORIA-2022.zip (PANGAEA 948492)
source.method: Latitude/Longitude columns of the per-spectrum metadata table

gloria.note: 7572 in-situ hyperspectral Rrs measurements, 30 countries, 486 named sites.

source.label: Hephaestus annotations + COMET LiCSAR frame polygons
source.method: centre of the LiCSAR frame polygon (<frame>-poly.txt) for each of the 38 frames named in the 19,919 annotation JSON files

hephaestus.note: 38 Sentinel-1 LiCSAR frames (~250 km) over volcanoes; interferograms per frame range 54-1330.

source.label: Landsat 7 scene ids in krisrs1128/glacier_mapping conf/masking_paths.yaml, footprints from Planetary Computer STAC
source.method: centre of each of the 35 Landsat 7 source scenes (WRS-2 path/row + date resolved through the landsat-c2-l2 STAC collection)

hkh-glacier-mapping.note: One point per Landsat scene (~185 km), not per 512 px patch; the 14,190 patches and their geojson metadata sit inside a 69 GB tar.gz (hkh_patches.tar.gz) on LILA.

source.label: HLS Burn Scars parquet conversion (image.path column)
source.method: MGRS 100 km tile ids parsed from scene filenames in the parquet image.path column; points are tile centres

hls-burn-scars.note: 804 scenes on 365 MGRS 100 km tiles; a point marks the tile centre, not the 15 km scene, since the tar.gz has no per-scene index and reading its GeoTIFFs would mean downloading 2.6 GB.

source.label: Inria Aerial Image Labeling dataset page
source.method: one point per named city (10 cities, 36 tiles each); the georeferenced tiles are only inside a 20 GB split 7z archive without an index

inria-aerial.note: 360 tiles of 1.5 x 1.5 km: train = Austin, Chicago, Kitsap County, Vienna, West Tyrol; test = Bellingham, Bloomington, Innsbruck, San Francisco, East Tyrol. City coordinates are approximate centres, not tile positions.

source.label: SustainBench crop type mapping (Kenya) page
source.method: approximate centre of each of the three surveyed counties (Bungoma, Busia, Siaya) named on the dataset page; field coordinates are not publicly indexed

kenya-crop-type.note: 5,693 fields / 39,568 S2 pixel time series (2017): Bungoma 2,098, Busia 1,957, Siaya 1,638 fields. Data only on Google Drive (drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Rq1F-ys-rkjftAUnbdGJ1T6udsZWnEyo), not downloadable from this environment.

source.label: M4D oil spill detection dataset page
source.method: no public index of image locations; access is by e-mail application and the images are non-georeferenced JPEG crops

krestenitis-oil-spill.note: ~1,000 train + 110 test JPEG crops of Sentinel-1 scenes at EMSA CleanSeaNet-reported spills in European seas, 2015-09-28 to 2017-10-31. The spill coordinates come from EMSA records that are not published with the dataset.

source.label: Zenodo 5005868, predicted_set.geojson (inside global_pv_inventory_all.zip)
source.method: centroid of every predicted PV facility polygon in predicted_set.geojson, extracted from the zip with one range request

kruitwagen-et-al-2021-solar-inventory.note: 68661 facility polygons in the predicted set (the ML-detected inventory, not the hand-labelled training polygons).

source.label: KuroSiwo pickle/KuroV2_grid_dict.gz (GitHub)
source.method: centre of each 2.24 km grid-cell polygon (EPSG:3857) in the dataset's grid dictionary

kuro-siwo-flood-s1.note: 31707 grid cells over 43 Copernicus EMS flood activations (GRD v2 release).

source.label: Landslide4Sense paper (Ghorbanzadeh et al. 2022)
source.method: approximate centre of each of the four event regions named in the paper; the released patches carry no coordinates

landslide4sense.note: 3,799 train / 245 val / 800 test patches of 1.28 km (S2 + ALOS PALSAR slope/DEM); the per-patch region is not published.

source.label: Copernicus-Bench lc100_s3.zip file listing (Hugging Face)
source.method: lon/lat decoded from the <id>_<lon>_<lat> sample names in the zip central directory (0.25 degree grid), one point per LC100 label patch

lc100-classification-segmentation.note: Classification and segmentation variants share the same patches. Only the zip central directory was read (HTTP range requests); patch centres are the grid-cell coordinates in the file names.

source.label: LoveDA paper city list; data on Zenodo 5706578
source.method: one city-centre point per city named in the paper; the PNG images carry no georeferencing and Zenodo has no location index

loveda.note: 5,987 0.3 m images (2,522 train / 1,669 val / 1,796 test) over urban and rural districts of Nanjing, Changzhou and Wuhan (Jiangsu/Hubei, China).

source.label: MADOS on Zenodo
source.method: no coordinates recoverable: patch GeoTIFFs in MADOS.zip are not georeferenced and scenes are anonymised

mados.note: 2,803 patches from 174 anonymised Sentinel-2 scenes (47 tiles, 2015-2022), globally distributed per the paper; the ISPRS paper's location map is an image only. A 4 GB zip with no index; not downloaded.

source.label: MagicBathyNet.zip (Zenodo)
source.method: centre of 300 randomly chosen Sentinel-2 180 m patches (img/s2), from GeoTIFF headers read inside the zip over HTTP, UTM -> WGS84

magicbathynet.note: 4,599 S2 patches (agia_napa 1,285, puck_lagoon 3,314); SPOT-6 and aerial patches are co-registered to the same footprints. 300 sampled (seed 0).

source.label: MARIDA repository docs/Report_1_Map.html (Zenodo 5152217)
source.method: 107181 annotated-polygon lat/lon points from the Plotly map report, averaged per (date, S2 tile, 2.56 km cell) to approximate the 1457 patch centres

marida.note: Patch centres are approximated from annotation locations (1,457 cells vs 1,381 patches); MARIDA.zip (1.1 GB) was not downloaded.

source.label: MARS-S2L train/val/test CSVs (Hugging Face)
source.method: lon/lat columns of the train, val and test CSVs (one row per image chip)

mars-s2l.note: Chips cluster on monitored oil/gas and coal sites; each site has many revisits, so distinct locations are far fewer than rows.

source.label: Massachusetts Buildings tiles (Mnih, U. Toronto)
source.method: centre of each GeoTIFF tile (EPSG:26986), header read over HTTP via rasterio /vsicurl/

massachusetts-buildings.note: 151 tiles of 1.5 x 1.5 km over the Boston area (train 137, valid 4, test 10).

source.label: Massachusetts Roads index pages (U. Toronto)
source.method: centre of each 1.5 km aerial tile decoded from its MassGIS tile id in the file name (EPSG:26986 -> WGS84), rule checked against four GeoTIFF headers

massachusetts-roads.note: 1171 tiles: train 1108, valid 14, test 49; 1 m aerial imagery over ~2,600 km2 of Massachusetts.

source.label: Global-scale mining polygons v2, PANGAEA 942325 (global_mining_polygons_v2.gpkg)
source.method: representative point of each of the 44,929 mine-area polygons in the GeoPackage (WGS84)

maus-et-al-2022-mining-polygons.note: Polygons in 145 countries; digitised on the 2019 Sentinel-2 cloudless mosaic within 10 km of S&P mine coordinates.

source.label: MethaneS2CM split CSVs (Hugging Face)
source.method: latitude/longitude columns of the train/test CSVs of the three splits (one row per patch)

methanes2cm.note: n_total counts rows across all three splits (patches are augmented crops of ~7k raw samples), so the same plume appears many times.

source.label: mmflood.zip mask GeoTIFFs (Zenodo)
source.method: centre of every flood-mask GeoTIFF tile (EPSG:4326), members read from the zip via HTTP range requests and Deflate64-inflated

mmflood.note: 1748 tiles across 333 Copernicus EMS activation parts (95 activations, 2014-2021).

source.label: MultiSenGE labels.zip (Zenodo 6375466)
source.method: patch centre = S2 tile upper-left corner (from the MGRS tile id) + 10 m x (pixel offset + 128), decoded from the label file names

source.label: Radiant MLHub nasa-marine-debris blob listing (labels/*.geojson names)
source.method: centre of the zoom-16 web-mercator tile encoded in each chip name (x-y-z suffix), one point per 256x256 PlanetScope chip

nasa-marine-debris.note: Mostly the Bay Islands, Honduras, with a few chips off Ghana and Greece (per the dataset README).

source.label: NeonTreeEvaluation annotations.zip (Zenodo 5914554) + NEON API plot/site locations
source.method: evaluation plots geolocated via NEON API <plot>.basePlot.all; training tiles decoded from the UTM easting/northing in their names

neontreeevaluation.note: One point per annotated image (226 XMLs across 22 NEON sites; 30,975 crowns). 8 names unresolved.

source.label: Next Day Wildfire Spread (arXiv 2112.02447)
source.method: contiguous-US bounding box from the paper; the Kaggle TFRecords carry no coordinates and Kaggle is not reachable here

next-day-wildfire-spread.note: 18,545 samples (64 km x 64 km, 2012-2020; train 14,979 / eval 1,877 / test 1,689) of MODIS fire masks and drivers over CONUS; sample locations are not published.

source.label: GEO-Bench m-nz-cattle sample ids (TACO repackaging, ISP-UV)
source.method: lon,lat embedded in every GEO-Bench sample id, read from METADATA/sample.parquet inside the zip over HTTP

nz-cattle.note: 655 chips of 500x500 px at 0.1 m; towns: Hamilton 561, Kapiti_Coast 54, Tauranga 40. The chips' own GeoTIFF transforms in the GEO-Bench export are wrong (0.1 deg/pixel), so the ids are used instead. Half of the samples are "_shifted" copies of the same locations.

source.label: Open-Canopy geometries.geojson (Hugging Face)
source.method: centroids of the 95,429 1 km tiles in geometries.geojson, reprojected from EPSG:2154 (Lambert-93) to EPSG:4326

open-canopy.note: Tiles per split: {'train': 66339, 'test': 13675, 'buffer': 8046, 'val': 7369}. 'buffer' tiles are not used for training or evaluation.

source.label: Open Cities AI Challenge STAC items on source.coop
source.method: polygon centroids of the 72 training-scene STAC items (tier 1 + tier 2 drone mosaics)

open-cities-ai.note: 72 training mosaics over 10 cities (Accra, Dar es Salaam, Kampala, Monrovia, Niamey, Pointe-Noire, Zanzibar, ...) hold the ~790k building labels; the 11481 test chips have a dummy (0,0) geometry in their STAC items, so they are not placed.

source.label: OpenEarthMap.zip label GeoTIFF headers (Zenodo)
source.method: centre of a stratified sample of label GeoTIFFs (3 per region) whose headers were read from the zip via HTTP range requests

openearthmap.note: 291 of 3500 label tiles sampled across 97 region folders (the 5,000-image count includes xBD-derived RGB images not in the zip); all tiles georeferenced in UTM.

source.label: PASTIS metadata.geojson
source.method: centroid of each 1.28 km patch polygon in metadata.geojson, reprojected EPSG:2154 -> EPSG:4326

pastis-pastis-r.note: Patches lie in four S2 tiles (T30UXV, T31TFM, T31TFJ, T32ULU); PASTIS-R shares the same patch grid.

source.label: PhenoCam network ROI list API (phenocam.nau.edu)
source.method: camera lat/lon of every PhenoCam site with an ROI record starting by 2018-12-31 (503 sites), a superset of the 393 v2.0 cameras

phenocam-v2-0.note: PhenoCam v2.0 itself (ORNL DAAC doi:10.3334/ORNLDAAC/1674) requires an Earthdata login; the exact 393-camera list is not published openly, so the live network list filtered by date is used.

source.label: PhilEO-downstream split zip on Hugging Face (central directory + GeoTIFF headers)
source.method: tile centres from the GeoTIFF headers of an even 300-of-846 subsample of the road-labelled 25 km Sentinel-2 tiles, inflating only the first 32 KB of each zip member

phileo-roads.note: 846 tiles carry a road-density label (of 1,392 PhilEO downstream tiles across east-africa, nigeria, europe, south-america, north-america, ghana, senegal, japan, denmark, egypt, ...). Region names only in file names; coordinates read from headers.

source.label: PLANTED paper (arXiv 2406.18554)
source.method: no public index: the GCS bucket gs://planted-datasets/public requires authenticated access and there is no mirror

planted.note: 2,264,747 examples (AnySat subset 1,346,662 tiles) with per-example lat/lon inside the TFRecords, 64 tree classes in 41 countries; the bucket denies anonymous reads, so no coordinates could be retrieved.

source.label: PureForest-patches.gpkg
source.method: centroid of each 50 m patch polygon in the metadata geopackage, EPSG:2154 -> WGS84

pureforest.note: 135,569 patches (each has a paired aerial image and ALS point cloud); the paper's 449 stands are the parent forest polygons.

source.label: GEO-Bench m-pv4ger sample ids (TACO METADATA/sample.parquet, Hugging Face isp-uv-es/geobench-m-pv4ger-taco)
source.method: chip centre lat/lon parsed from each GEO-Bench sample id (13,812 320x320 px chips at 0.1 m), read from the zip via HTTP range requests

pv4ger.note: Splits: {'train': 11814, 'validation': 999, 'test': 999}; classes: {'no solar pv': 11692, 'solar pv': 2120}. 0 ids could not be parsed. Chips come from North Rhine-Westphalia orthophotos (3D-PV-Locator, Mayer et al. 2022).

source.label: Zenodo 6397029, RTS_inventory.gpkg
source.method: centroid of each thaw-slump polygon in the GeoPackage

qtec-thaw-slump-inventory.note: 875 slump polygons along the Qinghai-Tibet Engineering Corridor (PlanetScope 2019 mapping).

source.label: QuakeSet epicenters.parquet (Hugging Face)
source.method: mean of the per-pixel lon/lat arrays stored for each Sentinel-1 patch

source.label: RapidAI4EO sample geometries (rapidai4eo_geometries.geojson.gz)
source.method: centre of each 600 m sample polygon in the official geometries file (WGS84)

rapidai4eo.note: Mirrored on source.coop (planet/rapidai4eo) and Azure; 3,000 of 500,000 locations stored.

source.label: ReforesTree mapping/final_dataset.csv (inside reforesTree.zip, Zenodo 6813783)
source.method: lon/lat of each of the 4663 mapped tree bounding boxes (lon_d, lat_d) across 6 drone-surveyed sites, read from the CSV via HTTP range requests into the zip

reforestree.note: Each point is one annotated tree; the six sites are small (~0.1 km2) agroforestry plots in Los Rios / Guayas, Ecuador, so points cluster into six tight groups.

source.label: S1S2-Water STAC items (sentinel12_<n>_meta.json inside the Zenodo zips)
source.method: bbox centres (EPSG:3857 -> WGS84) of the per-scene STAC item JSONs, read out of the zips with HTTP range requests

s1s2-water.note: One point per 100 km x 100 km Sentinel-2 tile-grid scene (S1 + S2 + DEM triplet).

source.label: Zenodo 4172871 shapefiles.zip
source.method: centroid of each subscene polygon in the per-subscene shapefiles (UTM -> WGS84)

s2-cloud-mask-catalogue.note: 513 subscenes (1022x1022 px, Sentinel-2 L1C), randomly sampled over land, 2018.

source.label: SDS_Benchmark transect GeoJSONs (GitHub)
source.method: centroid of each cross-shore transect line in datasets/<SITE>/<SITE>_transects.geojson (CRS84 lon/lat)

sds-benchmark.note: Transects per site: NARRABEEN 5, DUCK 33, TRUCVERT 176, TORREYPINES 79. Shoreline time series are evaluated per transect; Cala Millor (in sites_info.txt) has no transect file in the repo.

source.label: SEN12MS mediaTUM record and data share (seasons.csv, SupportingDocument.txt)
source.method: no public index of scene or patch coordinates; data only inside 12 tar.gz archives (421 GiB)

sen12ms.note: 252 ROI scenes sampled over global land masses in four seasons (2016-2017). seasons.csv on the share lists scene ids and hemisphere-corrected seasons but no coordinates; the authors' Sen12MSOverview notebook derives ROI positions from local GeoTIFF headers.

source.label: Sen1Floods11 STAC catalog (GCS bucket sen1floods11/v1.1/catalog.zip)
source.method: bbox centres of every *_source STAC item (one per 512x512 chip)

sen1floods11.note: 446 hand-labelled and 4384 weakly-labelled chips across 11 flood events.

source.label: Sen2Fire paper (arXiv 2403.17884), Fig. 1 study areas
source.method: New South Wales bounding box; the four study areas are shown only as a map figure

sen2fire.note: 2,466 512x512 patches from 4 Sentinel-2 scenes (864/594/504/504; areas 1-2 train, 3 val, 4 test) stored as non-georeferenced .npz in a 6.3 GB zip; no coordinates published.

source.label: Sen4AgriNet patch index (isp-uv-es/sen4agrinet-taco sample.parquet)
source.method: patch centre from <tile>_patch_<row>_<col>: S2 tile corner (MGRS id) + 3.66 km x (index + 0.5); 2019/2020 duplicates of the same cell merged

sen4agrinet.note: 10013 patch-years (Catalonia 2019-20, France 2019) over 7704 distinct grid cells in 11 S2 tiles; the original release also has Catalonia 2016-18 on the same grid.

source.label: SICKLE README / paper study-area description
source.method: approximate bounding box of the Cauvery Delta region named as the study area; plot coordinates are only in the form-gated Google Drive release

sickle-paddy-classification.note: 388 surveyed paddy plots (avg 0.38 acre), 2,370 time-series samples, Jan 2018-Mar 2021; data access requires a Google Form and Google Drive download, not used.

source.label: SICKLE paper (arXiv 2312.00069) study-region description
source.method: approximate district centres of the four Cauvery Delta districts named via the ICAR 2013 reclassification the paper cites; plot coordinates are withheld by the authors

sickle.note: 388 plots / 2,370 season samples, Jan 2018-Mar 2021. Data access requires a Google Form (Drive download); the paper states plot GPS centroids are withheld for privacy, so no sample-level footprint is possible. District identity is inferred, not stated verbatim in the paper.

source.label: So2Sat LCZ42 v4 *_geo.h5 (Hugging Face)
source.method: patch centre from each patch's UTM TFW transform (10 m pixels, 32 px) in the geolocation HDF5 files, reprojected to WGS84

so2sat-lcz42-lcz-s2.note: 400673 patches (training 352366, validation 24119, testing 24188) over 52 cities: amsterdam, beijing, berlin, bogota, buenosaires, cairo, capetown, caracas, changsha, chicago, cologne, dhaka, dongying, guangzhou, hongkong, islamabad, istanbul, jakarta, kyoto, lima, lisbon, london, losangeles, madrid, melbourne, milan, moscow, mumbai, munich, nairobi, nanjing, newyork, orangitown, paris, philadelphia, qingdao, quezon, riodejaneiro, rome, salvador, sanfrancisco, santiago, saopaulo, shanghai, shenzhen, sydney, tehran, tokyo, vancouver, washingtondc, wuhan, zurich.

source.label: source.coop radiantearth/south-africa-crops-competition label tiles
source.method: centre of 300 randomly sampled label GeoTIFFs (of 2650 train tiles) read from headers via /vsicurl

south-africa-crop-type.note: Subsample of 300 of 2650 2.56 km training tiles (no tile index file is published; the 1,137 test tiles carry imagery only); all in the Western Cape.

source.label: SpaceNet 2 TACO repackaging, .tacocat/sample.parquet (Hugging Face isp-uv-es/spacenet2-taco)
source.method: centre lon/lat (ml:lon, ml:lat) of every labelled 200 m chip in the four AOIs

spacenet-2.note: Chips per city: {'Shanghai': 4582, 'Vegas': 3851, 'Paris': 1148, 'Khartoum': 1012}; splits {'train': 6309, 'test': 2183, 'validation': 2101}. The 3,525 unlabelled test_public chips on AWS (14,118 chips in total) fall in the same AOIs.

source.label: spacenet-dataset S3 bucket, SN3_roads and SN5_roads PS-RGB GeoTIFFs
source.method: chip centres from the GeoTIFF headers of an even 300-of-6681 subsample of PS-RGB tiles across the 7 AOIs (train + test_public), read over /vsicurl

spacenet-3-5.note: 6681 PS-RGB chips: AOI_2_Vegas 989, AOI_3_Paris 310, AOI_4_Shanghai 1198, AOI_5_Khartoum 283, AOI_2_Vegas 330, AOI_3_Paris 104, AOI_4_Shanghai 399, AOI_5_Khartoum 95, AOI_7_Moscow 1353, AOI_8_Mumbai 1016, AOI_7_Moscow 228, AOI_8_Mumbai 157, AOI_9_San_Juan 219. SN3 = Vegas, Paris, Shanghai, Khartoum; SN5 = Moscow, Mumbai, San Juan.

source.label: SpaceNet 7 AOI folders on S3 (spacenet-dataset)
source.method: AOI folder names carry zoom-13 slippy-map tile x/y; decoded to the tile centre

spacenet-7.note: 80 public AOIs (60 train + 20 test_public); the ~21 private test AOIs are not public. Each AOI is one ~4 km x 4 km Planet mosaic tile with ~24 monthly images.

source.label: SpaceNet 8 on AWS (spacenet-dataset bucket)
source.method: centre of 300 randomly chosen PRE-event image tiles (stratified by area) from GeoTIFF headers read over HTTP, UTM -> WGS84

spacenet-8.note: PRE-event tiles: Germany_Training_Public 202, Louisiana-East_Training_Public 599, Louisiana-West_Test_Public 406. Two flood events: Ahr valley, Germany (July 2021) and Hurricane Ida, Louisiana, USA (Sept 2021); the test area is Louisiana-West.

source.label: USGS SPARCS l8cloudmasks.zip (entry list + GeoTIFF headers via HTTP ranges) and Planetary Computer Landsat STAC
source.method: exact 30 km subscene centres from the GeoTIFF IFD for 30 subscenes; parent Landsat 8 scene centres (WRS-2 path/row + date via STAC) for 50

sparcs.note: Subscenes are 1000x1000 px (30 km) crops of 80 Landsat 8 scenes, 2013-2014, worldwide. The USGS server refuses byte-range requests beyond ~600 MB into the archive, so later entries use the parent scene centre (within ~90 km of the subscene).

source.label: STARCOP train/test CSVs + JPL AVIRIS-NG 2019 flight-line KML
source.method: tile row/col windows from the CSV ids interpolated inside the AVIRIS-NG flight-line polygons of the JPL 2019 KML

starcop.note: 3767 tiles (train+test) on 300 Permian Basin flight lines; position along a flight line assumes the KML polygon's first edge is line 0 (error bounded by the strip length). 1 tiles unmatched.

source.label: Substation dataset metadata.tar.gz (GCS tz-ml-public)
source.method: lat/lon parsed from each per-sample metadata JSON file name (patch centre)

substations.note: 26522 Sentinel-2 patches (228 px, 2022-5-1 to 2023-5-1) centred on OSM substations worldwide (bucket folder 'substation-over-10km2'); positives only (the random-negative set is a separate bucket folder).

source.label: SustainBench crop yield prediction page
source.method: one approximate point per country soybean region (US, Argentina, Brazil); the administrative-unit keys are only inside the Google Drive download

sustainbench-crop-yield.note: 11,048 county-years of soybean yield (2005-16) over US counties, Argentine departments and Brazilian microregions; MODIS histograms. Data only on Google Drive (drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hsp2PlXAgcQ0pbx_vvPKHZcj_Am3rWx4), not downloadable from this environment.

source.label: SustainBench DHS datasets page / dhs_dataset.py download_url
source.method: cluster coordinates are only in dhs_final_labels.csv / dhs_metadata.csv on Google Drive (folder 1tzWDfd4Y5MvJnJb-lHieOuD-aVcUqzcu), which could not be fetched

sustainbench-dhs-tasks.note: ~87k-117k DHS clusters per task across 48-56 countries (surveys 1996-2019); coordinates are DHS-jittered (2 km urban / 5 km rural). See footprint yeh-et-al-2020 for the 23-country African subset.

source.label: SWED.zip file listing (UKHO S3) + test GeoTIFF headers
source.method: train chip centres decoded from the Sentinel-2 tile id and grid row/col in each filename; test chip centres from their GeoTIFF bounds

swed.note: 28224 training chips on 16 Sentinel-2 tiles (grid position inferred from the filename index, not from georeferencing, since the chips are .npy) and 98 hand-picked test chips.

source.label: Tallo database (Jucker et al. 2022), Zenodo 6637599
source.method: latitude/longitude of every tree record in Tallo.csv, the inventory TalloS samples are centred on (TalloS's own file list is not public)

tallos.note: 498838 Tallo tree records; TalloS keeps ~335k of them (areas with >= 50 trees, 1,000+ genera) as 2016-2023 S1/S2/DEM/ERA5 series. The TalloS archive (FoMo-Bench Dropbox folder, 156 GB zip) has no index, so points are the parent database.

source.label: TimeSen2Crop.zip directory (Zenodo)
source.method: centre of the MGRS 100 km square of each Sentinel-2 tile folder in the zip; per-pixel coordinates are not published

source.label: TreeSatAI geojson.zip (bb_60m.GeoJSON)
source.method: centroids of the 60 m patch polygons in bb_60m.GeoJSON, reprojected from EPSG:25832

source.label: WildfireSpreadTS TACO repackaging, .tacocat/sample.parquet
source.method: ml:lon/ml:lat centre of each of the 607 fire-event rasters in the TACO sample index

wildfirespreadts.note: One point per fire event (raster 111-128 km across). Index comes from the ISP-UV TACO repackaging of the Zenodo release, not the Zenodo zip itself.

source.label: WorldFloods v2 dataset_metadata.csv (Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each flood map's UTM bounds, reprojected to WGS84

worldfloods-v2.note: 509 flood-map/S2 pairs across train/val/test (Copernicus EMS activations).

source.label: xBD label geometry via isp-uv-es/xview2-taco sample.parquet
source.method: first WGS84 building vertex of each image pair's label polygons (ml:polygon_lnglat), read from the TACO metadata inside the zip over HTTP

xbd-xview2.note: 11,034 image pairs over 19 events (portugal-wildfire 1869, pinery-bushfire 1845, socal-fire 1403, woolsey-fire 878, nepal-flooding 619, hurricane-michael 550, hurricane-florence 546, hurricane-harvey 522, midwest-flooding 445, hurricane-matthew 405, santa-rosa-wildfire 377, tuscaloosa-tornado 343, lower-puna-volcano 291, moore-tornado 227, palu-tsunami 196, mexico-earthquake 193, joplin-tornado 149, sunda-tsunami 148, guatemala-volcano 28); 3858 pairs contain no building and get no point. 3,000 of 7,176 stored.

source.label: xView TACO repackaging, METADATA/sample.parquet inside xview.zip (Hugging Face isp-uv-es/xview-taco)
source.method: centre lon/lat (ml:lon, ml:lat) of each of the 846 released WorldView-3 training images, read from the zip via HTTP range requests

xview.note: 846 train/val images with 601,774 boxes in the public release (the ~1M-object figure includes the withheld test set). Splits: {'train': 653, 'test': 105, 'validation': 88}.

source.label: xView3-SAR paper (arXiv 2206.00897), Table 2 regions
source.method: one hand-placed centre per region named in the paper; scene footprints and label CSVs are behind registration at iuu.xview.us

xview3-sar.note: 991 Sentinel-1 scenes, 243,018 objects, over five regional groupings: Adriatic Sea; Bay of Biscay; Gulf of Guinea (West Africa); Iceland; Norway (North Sea / Norwegian Sea). Per-scene coordinates not public without an account.

source.label: africa_poverty/data/dhs_clusters.csv (GitHub)
source.method: DHS cluster lat/lon from the repository's cluster table (one row per village)

yeh-et-al-2020.note: 19669 DHS clusters, 23 countries, surveys 2009-2016; DHS coordinates are jittered up to 2 km (urban) / 5 km (rural).

source.label: ZueriCrop label map COG (crop-classification/zueri-crop-2 mirror)
source.method: centre of every 24x24 px (240 m) window of the 5120x5120 label raster that contains a labelled pixel, EPSG:32632 -> WGS84

zuericrop.note: 28,193 labelled windows reconstructed (paper: 27,977 patches over Zurich/Thurgau, 48 classes); the HDF5 release itself has no georeference. 3,000 stored.
